title: 第3章 你是寄居蟹吗第4章 新系统
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
不管系统说什么，和铃都不理它。
姜暮烟转过身，示意和铃上来，“我背你去找师尊。”
和铃感动地趴在她背上，轻声说道：“多谢师姐。”
姜暮烟听到小师妹这么亲近地和自己说话，高兴得快要飞起。
前脚刚出了闭关室，夜弦和梁音儿就追了出来。
夜弦死死盯着和铃的背影，威胁道：“和铃，你当真要一走了之，弃梁师姐的安危于不顾吗？”
“你今天要是跟着姜暮烟走了，日后就别来找我！”
“我再也不会对你笑，也不会收你的任何东西了，你别后悔！”
和铃懒洋洋道：“谁找谁是蛤蟆狗。”
说完，语气又转为亲昵，“师姐，我们快点走吧，别被狗皮膏药黏上了。”
姜暮烟努力压下上扬的唇角，“好。”
她唤了一声，“紫烟剑。”
紫烟剑瞬间落在脚下，姜暮烟踩着飞剑，朝混元峰的方向飞去，速度极快，南华宗的弟子抬头只能看见一道紫色的残光。
天上风大，姜暮烟贴心地给了和铃一个灵力罩。
回到混元峰后，她直接背着和铃去了师尊明瑟真君的住所。
“师尊！小师妹她吐血了！”
人还在殿外，姜暮烟的声音就传进了大殿。
身着松烟色长裙的明瑟真君走了出来，吩咐身边的侍童道：“搭把手，将阿铃扶进去。”
“不用这么麻烦，我背小师妹进去就行，省得还要颠她一下。”
两名侍童退下，跟着一起进了偏殿。

殿内不知道烧着什么香，清雅冷冽，闻着格外令人心安。
和铃被放到了床上，明瑟真君抬手落下殿内的纱幔，对其他人道：“出去等着。”
明瑟真君的声音清冷雅致，平淡中透着温柔。
她扶起和铃，将手搭在她的腕上，粗略一查探，震惊地蹙起了眉头。
“阿铃……你的金丹怎么在逸散？”
修士初入仙道，开辟气海，引气入体后，灵气在体内形成一个气旋。
随着不断修炼，气旋越发壮大，将其压缩成一颗金色的丹体，此时修士也就步入金丹境了。
和铃大致知道，金丹逸散相当于冰块化成水的过程。
明瑟真君连忙往她体内送入一股自己的灵力，包裹住那颗在自行消解的金丹。
“阿铃，我先封住你的修为，在没有找到此事的解决办法之前，你不要动用灵力了。”
“若无必要，也不要离开混元峰，免得受了伤，有什么事情就喊你几位师兄师姐去做，如果非要下山的话，至少也要喊一位师兄师姐跟着，明白吗？”
和铃乖巧地点了点头，暗戳戳道：“师尊，你再检查一下我的识海吧，我总感觉头疼。”
系统这种东西，一般都是藏在识海里面，不管有没有用，她总要试一下才甘心。
明瑟真君并起双指，点在和铃的眉心，一道柔和的灵光扩散开来。
和铃一动不敢动，她识海内的系统也藏得死死的，安静无比。
许久过后，明瑟真君垂下手，摇了摇头，道：“阿铃，我没有在你的识海发现任何异常。”
“至于你所说的头疼，可能是其他原因引起的，稍后我让暮烟送几粒安神丹过来，你服下后看看有没有好转。”
明瑟真君替她掖了掖被子，“你好好休息。”
content_en:
No matter what the system said, He Ling ignored it.
Jiang Muyan turned around and motioned for He Ling to come up, "I will carry you to find the master."
He Ling lay on her back moved and said softly: "Thank you, senior sister."
Jiang Muyan was so happy when she heard her junior sister talking to her so intimately.
As soon as he left the retreat room, Ye Xian and Liang Yin'er chased him out.
Ye Xian stared at He Ling's back and threatened, "He Ling, are you really going to run away and ignore Senior Sister Liang's safety?"
"If you follow Jiang Muyan today, don't come to me in the future!"
"I will never smile at you again, nor will I accept anything from you. Don't regret it!"
He Ling said lazily: "Whoever is looking for is a toad dog."
After saying that, his tone turned to intimacy again, "Senior sister, let's go quickly, don't get stuck by the dog-skin plaster."
Jiang Muyan tried hard to suppress the raised corners of her lips, "Okay."
She called out, "Purple Smoke Sword."
The Purple Smoke Sword fell at his feet in an instant. Jiang Muyan stepped on the flying sword and flew in the direction of Hunyuan Peak at such a fast speed that the disciples of the Nanhua Sect could only see a purple residual light when they looked up.
It was windy in the sky, so Jiang Muyan thoughtfully gave He Ling a spiritual shield.
After returning to Hunyuan Peak, she carried He Ling directly to the residence of her master, Mingse Zhenjun.
"Master! Junior sister, she vomited blood!"
While people were still outside the hall, Jiang Muyan's voice came into the hall.
Wearing a pine smoke-colored dress, True Lord Mingse came out and ordered the servant beside him: "Give me your hand and help Ah Ling in."
"There's no need to go to such trouble. I can just carry my junior sister in so that I don't have to bump her around."
The two servants withdrew and followed them into the side hall.
I don't know what kind of incense is burning in the hall. It is elegant and cold, and the smell is particularly reassuring.
He Ling was put on the bed. Lord Mingse raised his hand and lowered the gauze curtain in the hall, saying to the others: "Go out and wait."
Lord Mingse's voice was cold and elegant, with gentleness in his plainness.
She helped He Ling up, put her hand on her wrist, and after a cursory inspection, she frowned in shock.
"A Ling...why is your golden elixir escaping?"
When a monk first enters the immortal path, he opens up the sea of ​​qi and introduces the qi into his body. The spiritual qi forms a cyclone in his body.
With continuous practice, the cyclone becomes stronger and stronger, compressing it into a golden elixir body. At this time, the monk has entered the golden elixir realm.
He Ling roughly knows that the escape of golden elixir is equivalent to the process of ice turning into water.
True Lord Mingse quickly sent a burst of his spiritual power into her body, wrapping the golden elixir that was dissolving on its own.
"A-Ling, I'll seal your cultivation first. Don't use your spiritual power until we find a solution to this matter."
"If it's not necessary, don't leave Hunyuan Peak to avoid getting hurt. If anything happens, just ask your senior brothers and sisters to do it. If you have to go down the mountain, at least ask one of your senior brothers and sisters to follow you. Do you understand?"
He Ling nodded obediently and said secretly: "Master, please check my sea of consciousness again. I always feel a headache."
Things like the system are usually hidden in the sea of consciousness. No matter whether it is useful or not, she will always give it a try before she is willing to do it.
True Lord Mingse raised his fingers together and touched He Ling's eyebrows, and a soft spiritual light spread out.
He Ling didn't dare to move, and the system in her consciousness was also tightly hidden, extremely quiet.
After a long time, True Lord Mingse lowered his hand, shook his head, and said, "A-Ling, I didn't find anything abnormal in your sea of consciousness."
"As for the headache you mentioned, it may be caused by other reasons. I will ask Mu Yan to send some soothing pills to you later. You can take them and see if they get better."
True Lord Mingse tucked the quilt for her, "You have a good rest."
